nodes.label: Destination Pages Before Directories Rule
nodes.rationale: Directories are link-equity sources; alternative/use-case/template pages are the destinations that convert that traffic (5-15% vs 0.5-2% for generic content) — build destinations first so the link equity has somewhere useful to land.

nodes.label: Foundation Before Submission Rule
nodes.rationale: Never submit to a directory until the destination landing page is live, indexed, and meets SEO/GEO readiness criteria (single H1, pricing page, privacy/terms, logo assets, screenshots, demo video, FAQ schema, structured data) — because clean-hierarchy pages get 2.8x higher AI citation rates and directories are worthless without a converting destination.

nodes.label: G2/Capterra 10-in-30 Review Protocol
nodes.rationale: Listings are worthless without reviews (10 is the Grid-appearance threshold); protocol asks 20 users directly via email with a modest incentive to reach ~50% conversion, because G2/Capterra explicitly allow small incentives and direct links reduce friction ~70%.

nodes.label: Positioning Varies by Directory Type Rule
nodes.norm_label: positioning varies by directory type rule
nodes.rationale: Never reuse the same description across directories — AI engines penalize duplicate content and each directory audience (startup founders, SaaS alternative-seekers, AI-first buyers, devs, no-coders, B2B reviewers) responds to different framing.

nodes.label: Product Hunt 2026 Comment-Quality Algorithm
nodes.rationale: 2026 PH algorithm weights comment quality over upvote count; 80% of failed launches fail from launching without a warm audience or asking for upvotes instead of feedback, so the skill instructs asking for feedback and never for upvotes.

nodes.label: Lead Sentence Varies by Tier Framework
nodes.norm_label: lead sentence varies by tier framework
nodes.rationale: Each directory tier's audience scans for a different opening claim (outcome for founders, alternative framing for SaaS search intent, AI-first for AI directories, MCP-native for agent registries, no-code speed, technical depth for devs, ROI language for B2B review sites) — matching the lead sentence to audience intent raises conversion of the listing itself.

nodes.label: Logo Strip Marquee Time-Driven Finding
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: DOM contains the 4 client logos duplicated 4x (16 total img nodes) for a seamless infinite-loop marquee — implementation is time-driven continuous auto-scroll via CSS animation, not click/hover, replicate with duplicated logo set + translate -50% keyframe.

nodes.label: Navbar Does Not Change on Scroll Finding
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.norm_label: navbar does not change on scroll finding
nodes.rationale: Scrolled 600px and re-measured .navbar computed styles (background, boxShadow, position, height, backdropFilter) — all identical before/after, so the navbar is absolute-positioned, transparent, overlays the hero permanently with no sticky/shrink behavior to build.

nodes.label: GSAP ScrollTrigger + SplitText Reveal Mechanism
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: Site-wide scroll-reveal is implemented via GSAP ScrollTrigger + SplitText splitting headings and staggering card fade+translateY entrances; clone should use IntersectionObserver + CSS keyframes instead to avoid the GSAP dependency while preserving the visual effect.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Stripe OAuth Mock-Key Gap
nodes.rationale: /api/v1/stripe/callback currently stores a mock restricted key instead of exchanging the OAuth code at connect.stripe.com/oauth/token — the one piece standing between 'looks connected' and 'is actually connected', must be fixed before any real user touches Settings.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Reminder Auto-Pause-on-Payment Gap
nodes.rationale: A reminder sequence currently only stops if a human pauses it; once the Stripe webhook lands it must mark sequences completed the moment an invoice flips to paid — flagged as the trust-critical bug, since a paid client still getting a Day 7 reminder breaks confidence immediately.

nodes.label: Foreman/Builder Extraction Pattern
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: Not a two-phase inspect-then-build process — the orchestrator acts as a foreman walking the job site, writing a detailed spec file per section then handing it to a specialist builder agent so extraction and construction happen in parallel while extraction stays meticulous and auditable.

nodes.label: Spec Files Are the Source of Truth Principle
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.norm_label: spec files are the source of truth principle
nodes.rationale: Every component must get a written spec file before a builder is dispatched, both as the contract for the builder's prompt and as a persistent auditable artifact for later review; skipping it means the builder guesses to fill gaps.

nodes.label: CI Generated-Files Sync Check
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: CI reruns sync-agent-rules.sh and sync-skills.mjs then fails the build if git status shows drift, enforcing that AGENTS.md/SKILL.md sources and their generated platform files (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, copilot-instructions.md) never fall out of sync.

nodes.label: NOT the Next.js You Know Rule Block
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.norm_label: not the next.js you know rule block
nodes.rationale: Warns coding agents that this Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes vs training data; instructs reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. Block is auto-generated by `next dev` (verified at node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js) so removing it from a diff just recreates the change on next dev run; committing it keeps tree clean.

nodes.label: Pixel-Perfect Emulation Principle
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: Match the target site's spacing, colors, and typography exactly with no personal aesthetic changes during the emulation phase, then customize later — real content over placeholders, beauty in every pixel.

nodes.label: Worktree-per-Teammate Orchestration Principle
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: When launching Claude Code agent teams, each teammate works in its own worktree branch; the orchestrator merges everyone's work at the end and resolves conflicts smartly since only it holds full context of goals and achieved work.

nodes.label: Foundation First Principle
nodes.rationale: Global CSS design tokens, TypeScript content types, and global assets must exist before any component build starts — this step is sequential and non-negotiable, everything after can be parallel.

nodes.label: "Get Paid Faster" Positioning
nodes.rationale: Audience-neutral positioning deliberately broadened beyond a freelancer wedge, since anyone who sends invoices and gets paid late (agencies, contractors, consultants, landlords, solo SaaS founders) shares the same problem — the freelancer framing was a wedge, not the ceiling.

nodes.label: Phase 5: Broaden Beyond Stripe-Only
nodes.rationale: Manual invoice tracking and a Mark-as-Paid override are required so anyone paid by bank transfer, check, or invoiced via QuickBooks/Xero (most small businesses) isn't locked out — this phase is what actually makes the 'not just freelancers' audience pivot real; don't market 'works for everyone' until it does.

nodes.label: Why No Cloudflare Decision
nodes.rationale: Originally chose Cloudflare Workers for the reminder cron+queue, but two codebases and two deploy pipelines meant more places for state to drift, for a workload Vercel Cron + Next.js route handlers handle fine at this scale; fold-into-Next.js wins on operational simplicity until proven load or cost forces a split back out.

nodes.label: Identify Interaction Model Before Building Principle
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.norm_label: identify interaction model before building principle
nodes.rationale: Building a click-based UI when the original is scroll-driven (or vice versa) is the single most expensive cloning mistake, forcing a full rewrite instead of a CSS fix — determine by scrolling first without clicking, then testing hover/click only if nothing changed on scroll.

nodes.label: Small Tasks, Perfect Results Principle
nodes.community_name: Repo Docs, Skills & Aeline Clone Research
nodes.rationale: An agent given an entire complex section approximates and guesses; an agent given one focused component with exact CSS values nails it — complexity budget rule: if a builder prompt exceeds ~150 lines of spec, split the section further.
